projected_costs._premium_basis: Balanced 112 + 12 RDS Multi-AZ uplift (db.t4g.micro at the cached Multi-AZ rate: 0.032 x 730 + 10 GB x 0.23 = 25.66 ~ 26 vs 14 single-AZ) = 124. Fargate is task-size driven (no uplift); ALB, S3, security baseline, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager and ECR have no AZ-rate variant.
projected_costs._optimized_basis: Eligible subtotal 22 = Fargate 22 (Compute Savings Plan 30%, mid-point of 20-40% -> 7); ineligible subtotal 90 unchanged (ALB, S3, NAT Gateway, security baseline, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, ECR, plus RDS 14). RDS db.t4g.micro 14 is ineligible for the Database Savings Plan: it is Generation 4 and Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only (AWS Savings Plans FAQ, read 2026-11-27); a Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g) would qualify at 20%. 112 - 7 = 105.

premium: RDS Multi-AZ instead of single-AZ (+$12/mo - db.t4g.micro at the cached Multi-AZ rate) - removes the single-AZ assumption; no other line has an unapplied Multi-AZ uplift
optimized: Assumes a 1-year no-upfront Compute Savings Plan on Fargate at 30%, the mid-point of 20-40% (-$7/mo) - a commitment decision after a 30-90 day usage baseline

No Database Savings Plan on RDS: db.t4g.micro is Generation 4 and Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only, so the RDS line is unchanged (a Generation 7+ class would qualify at ~20%)
